thread:
incident-bot: PAGER: HIGH severity incident for customer AxionCorp (private VPC). NLB target group for axion-prod-1 returning 503/502 across routes -> api.axioncorp.internal. Alert: 25% 5xx rate for dedicated pool axion-prod-1 in us-west-2. Graphs: https://grafana.redwood/d/axion/axion-prod-1
oncall_alex: I'm oncall, taking this. Paging net-eng + SRE. @net-eng-sara can you join?
net-eng-sara: joining. quick glance: do we have any recent SG or NACL deploys for axion-prod-1?
eng-sre-miguel: I see NLB 502/503 spikes. Backends report TLS handshake failures in proxy logs. Posting snippet: ```proxy: client_ssl_error: no shared cipher; upstream prematurely closed connection```
customer-success-jen: Customer reports errors started ~08:12 PT. Impact: ~12% of API requests getting 5xx, some timeouts. They've opened a ticket and are watching.
oncall_alex: Triage checklist: 1) confirm SG/NACL 2) check conntrack on NATs 3) inspect cert rotation events 4) DNS TTL and fallback plan
net-eng-sara: Checked config history — config-mgmt ran `sg-drift-fix` around 1754989000 but no console changes. Running `aws ec2 describe-security-groups --group-ids sg-0a1b2c3d` now.
eng-sre-miguel: Running live tail on proxies shows many `SSL handshake failed` from a subset of backend IPs (10.2.5.*). Also see conntrack counters climbing on NAT instances.
support-bot: Deploy-bot: Canary rollback started for `sg-drift-fix` on axion-prod-1 — status: in_progress
oncall_alex: We should check conntrack exhaustion. If it's the NATs, we can flush selectively. Planning a staggered `sudo conntrack -F` on nat-a then nat-b. @sara ok?
net-eng-sara: Do it. Also temporary tweak: increase NLB healthcheck timeout to 10s to reduce flapping: `aws elbv2 modify-target-group --health-check-timeout-seconds 10 --target-group-arn arn:aws:...`
eng-sre-miguel: Flushed conntrack on nat-a. Observability: p99 latency down, 503 rate dropped from 25% -> 7%.
customer-success-jen: Customer says errors decreased significantly but still seeing intermittent failures from some geos. Asking for ETA to full recovery.
oncall_alex: Plan B if errors persist: shift small % to reserved fallback pool (axion-fallback) via Route53 weighted record with TTL=30. Prepare change set but hold until we confirm.
net-eng-sara: Prepared change file `axion-weighted-fallback.json` with weight 10 -> axion-fallback. Ready to `change-resource-record-sets` on your call.
eng-sre-miguel: NLB logs show TLS errors reduced after conntrack flush. I suspect a partial cert rotation: one proxy shard still served old/expired certs.
oncall_alex: Can we validate certs on the backend nodes? `openssl s_client -connect 10.2.5.12:443 -servername api.axioncorp.internal`
net-eng-sara: Ran check: one node returned expired leaf cert. Rolling restart of proxy fleet to pick up new cert from KMS/sidecar. Starting rolling restart now.
support-bot: Rolling restart job job-7723 for proxy fleet started by eng-sre-miguel
eng-sre-miguel: Restarts progressing, healthchecks returning healthy. Error rate now ~0.5%. Mobile clients still see cached failing connections (they'll recover over a few minutes).
customer-success-jen: AxionCorp: confirms major traffic restored. Residual errors from some mobile users but overall service is back. They request RCA and timeline for mitigation.
oncall_alex: Root cause hypothesis: partial proxy cert rotation failed to propagate to all proxy nodes + NAT conntrack pressure amplified error surface. Immediate remediation: rolled proxy restarts, conntrack flush, transient NLB timeout increase. Followups: add rollout verification, alert for cert propagation failures, tune conntrack capacity or SNAT pool autoscaling, add Route53 weighted-fallback playbook.
net-eng-sara: I'll open a follow-up PR to config-mgmt adding a rollout check (verify cert thumbprint on all proxies before marking deploy green) and add runbook entry for weighted DNS fallback.
eng-sre-miguel: I'll draft RCA and customer-facing summary. Will post draft in ~2h for review.
incident-bot: INCIDENT STATUS: downgraded to LOW. Incident start: 1755012345, end: 1755012945. :thumbsup:
